verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents dunning emails that ask customers to update their payment details, and it offers hosted pages for card payment methods. That is thin support for the self-service, hosted update-payment part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows cards updating themselves automatically. Missing for 10: network account updater (automatic card refresh), backup/fallback payment methods, an explicitly documented hosted update-payment-method page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages

citations.quote: you can send email reminders to your customers asking them to update payment details
Hosted pages are the easiest way to integrate Chargebee with your website. For card payment methods, they help meet most of your PCI DSS compliance requirements.
